Automated Model Briefing

⚠ AI-generated text — may be wrong, incomplete, or overconfident. This is automated commentary on experimental model output, not flight advice and not a weather forecast. It has not been reviewed by a meteorologist.

Overall Assessment Widespread rain and high cloud cover dominate the Reno area on 31 Oct, making it a poor flying day. Sharp lapse rates (~9°C/km) would support strong thermals, but overdevelopment and precipitation create unsafe conditions at all sites. A few sites have brief morning windows with lighter winds before rain intensifies, but cloud suck and poor visibility are likely.

Site Breakdown

  • Kingsbury grade: Unfavorable — rain and increasing cross winds. Short window 9–11am (SE 2–4 mph), w* to 265 fpm, thermal ceiling 1766 ft AGL. Advanced only (lapse 9.1°C/km).
  • Hallelujah: Unfavorable — 100% cloud, rain. Late-day ridge window 3–5pm has WSW 6–14 mph but dying thermals (w* <150 fpm, ceiling <1000 ft AGL); day's peak w* 334 fpm/ceiling 3050 ft AGL occurs with cross winds. Advanced only (lapse 8.7°C/km).
  • Slide Mountain: Unfavorable — rain, strong winds, 73% overdevelopment. Brief window 11am–1pm (SSE 9–15 mph), peak w* 371 fpm, ceiling 2657 ft AGL, but extreme cloud suck risk. Advanced only (lapse 8.3°C/km).
  • McClellan: Unfavorable — rain and 91% cloud. Best window 10am–4pm (S–SSW 6–13 mph), peak w* 396 fpm, ceiling 3100 ft AGL, but rain and marginal visibility. Advanced only (lapse 9.0°C/km).
  • West McClellan: Unfavorable — rain and mostly cross winds. Brief 5pm window (W 12–14 mph) with w* 131 fpm, ceiling 1117 ft AGL; day's peak w* 376 fpm/ceiling 2960 ft not usable. Advanced only (lapse 8.7°C/km).
  • Peavine Mountain: Unfavorable — rain, strong winds, 86% overdevelopment. Short lull 12–1pm (SW 5–8 mph) with w* to 223 fpm, ceiling 1191 ft AGL, but high cloud suck risk. Advanced only (lapse 8.0°C/km).
  • Rainbow Ridge: Unfavorable — rain and low-level shear. Window 10am–1pm (ENE 4–7 mph), w* to 272 fpm, ceiling 2301 ft AGL. Hazardous layer shear 6 mph at 2,611 ft AGL. Advanced only (lapse 9.2°C/km).
  • Duck Hill: Unfavorable — rain, and wind direction never aligns with preferred NW–N; no flyable window. Day's peak w* 409 fpm, ceiling 4646 ft AGL not usable. Advanced only (lapse 9.4°C/km).
  • Daydreams: Unfavorable — strong SW winds 18–28 mph, 100% overdevelopment, rain. Continuous thermals (peak w* 315 fpm, ceiling 3247 ft AGL) but extreme cloud suck and wind hazard. Advanced only (lapse 8.5°C/km).

Hazards

  • Rain: Widespread precipitation (regional peak 18.8 mm/hr) at all sites.
  • Overdevelopment / cloud suck: Slide Mountain (73%), Peavine Mountain (86%), Daydreams (100%) have LCL within 10% of PBLH, indicating high risk of being pulled into clouds.
  • Low-level wind shear: Hazardous speed shear at Slide Mountain (5 mph/layer at 235 ft AGL) and Rainbow Ridge (6 mph/layer at 2,611 ft AGL). McClellan has a layer direction change of 36° (hazardous).
  • Sharp thermals: All sites have lapse rates 8.0–9.4°C/km — rowdy conditions requiring expert technique.
  • Rotor / lee turbulence: Possible downwind of Peavine Mtn and Carson Range ridgelines given moderate–strong afternoon winds.
  • Icing: Freezing levels vary 8,660–9,625 ft MSL across sites; entering clouds above these altitudes poses an icing risk.

Site Forecast ?Top of Thermals (PBLH) — height of the turbulent mixing layer; thermals typically reach this ceiling.

w* — convective velocity scale; higher = stronger thermals (ft/min).
